'''Kelkad''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] fruit vendor, who worked alongside his father, [[Barada (Kelkad's father)|Barada]], in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Treema]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. In [[44 ABY]], he sold [[pak'pah]]s to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] acquaintance, [[Vestara Khai]].
